_comment: Per-subject LAYOUT/OCR rules for the Gen-3 splitter (tools/ocr_to_split.py). Section counts, marks and mc/short style live in syllabus.json 'sections' (the single source of truth, also read by invariants.py) — this file holds ONLY the geometry/OCR knobs that vary by paper layout, so a new subject or layout family is a config edit, not a code change.
